title: spec(security): the field-permission `when` description and the authorization guide still say only declaring sets vote; a View All / Modify All set now votes on every field
body:
domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQxwoGb5fSnrFkpxmt

立卡门: ① 已落地工作欠的后续。PR #29387(#29106,裁决 6573563853 字母 A)的合约复审 6579089871 should-fix 1 点名;落点具名,两处文字。
业务理由: 作者、AI 与复审都按 `FieldPermission.when` 的已发布描述和 authorization 指南判断字段权限怎么合并。#29387 落地后，持「查看全部」的权限集对该对象每个字段投可读，持「修改全部」的投可读可编辑(ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ 2026-11-02 附注已记录，PR #29459)。可这两处仍只写「只有声明了的集合投票」。不修的话，读者会以为应用集的 `readable: false` 仍能挡住管理员。
动手的读者: domain:spec 席。改两处文字：`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` 中 `when` 的 `.describe`(约 L984,"the rule that only declaring sets vote are unchanged"),以及 `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx` ⑧ 的 FLS posture 段(约 L151–159)。同一笔重生成 `content/docs/references/**` 的产物。
查重: `permission when description declaring sets vote` 2 命中、`superuser field mask lint viewAllRecords readable false` 3 命中(#29106 本身及无关两张)。没有改这两处文字的卡。

Follow-up of: #29106 (PR #29387, ADR note PR #29459)

## What is stale
- `packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` `FieldPermission.when` `.describe(...)`: "...the most-permissive merge across the caller's sets and the rule that only declaring sets vote are unchanged...". This is rendered into `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` and `content/docs/references/security/permission.mdx`.
- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`, the "FLS posture (ADR-0066 ⑧)" paragraph, still describes declaring-only voting with no super-user vote. `field-level-security.mdx` already got the sentence in #29387.

## Wanted
- Both texts name the super-user vote. A set holding `viewAllRecords` on an object votes `readable: true` on every field of it. `modifyAllRecords` votes `readable: true` and `editable: true`. View All never grants an edit. Otherwise union without deny is unchanged.
- Describe-only edit. ⛔ No schema shape change. Regenerate the reference pages through the repo's generator, and pass `check:generated`.
- `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. patch for spec (describe text).
